column1: # THE HAND-OUTS (BUILD-DELTA #36; Codex batch-3 r6 MAJOR 3): the production code's own functions that hand a drawn value or
# a credential to their own callers (through a return value or another sink the reconcile, src/handouts.rs, derives), so
# every caller uses a draw without naming a deny-list entry. Each is listed here AND in clippy.toml's own entries (so its
# callers are sites), must hold a reported draw itself, and must be derived as a candidate by the reconcile.
# file<TAB>item<TAB>own clippy path<TAB>what it hands out

column4: <prefix>_ + two UUIDv4: bootstrap, session, SCIM and invite tokens
n alphanumeric characters from the thread CSPRNG: OAuth state, nonce and PKCE verifier
the automation webhook trigger token (whk_ + two UUIDv4)
base64url of n thread-CSPRNG bytes: Google OAuth state and PKCE verifier
the per-process decision nonce: dp_ + hex of 12 random bytes
an interaction id: interaction://<kind>/<UUIDv4>
the standing-authority draw nonce (thread CSPRNG bytes)
a machine operation ref (UUIDv4)
a provider operation proposal nonce (alphanumeric, thread CSPRNG)
the guest effect capability (wec_, OsRng)
the governed provider effect capability (wbt_, OsRng)
the signer's Ed25519 keypair, generated when absent
a firewall receipt signing key (Ed25519)
the model-mount capability token plan: the ioi_mnt_ secret and its id (OsRng)
a randomly chosen browser User-Agent (thread CSPRNG)
the capability lease bearer (ioi_lease_ + hex of 32 OsRng bytes), returned with its lease: env-ops, editor and preview access tokens (Codex batch-3 r6 MAJOR 3)
a decision attempt id (dec_ + 12 random bytes), returned (Codex batch-3 r6 MAJOR 3)
the approval claim nonce (hex of 16 random bytes), returned in the ClaimedApproval (the reconcile)
the operator decision's reply, from the approve job that carries the decision attempt id (begin_deciding) (the reconcile)
the editor runtime connection token (hex of 32 OsRng bytes) and its nonce, returned with the runtime (the reconcile; the sitting's editor token)
the editor proxy host label (p<hex>.localhost, 8 random bytes), returned with the proxy (the reconcile)
the environment disposal receipt id (gen_opaque), returned (the reconcile)
an interaction id (fresh_interaction) when the request names none, returned (the reconcile)
an agent id (agent_ + UUIDv4), returned in the agent (the reconcile)
an agent run id (run_ + UUIDv4), returned in the run (the reconcile)
the authority gate's capability lease ref, decided with an approval claim (claim_approval_ref) and a standing draw nonce (standing_draw_nonce) (the reconcile)
the bootstrap token (ioi_bootstrap via gen_opaque), returned (the reconcile)
a session token (ioi_sess via gen_opaque), returned (the reconcile)
a GitHub App JWT (an RS256-signed bearer, jsonwebtoken::encode), returned (the reconcile)
the portal session exchange's reply and its admission attempt ref (UUIDv4) (the reconcile)
an OAuth ceremony: its state, nonce and PKCE verifier (random_token), returned (the reconcile)
the legacy OAuth start's reply with its random_token seed and ceremony (the reconcile)
a provider operation proposal with its nonce (random_proposal_nonce), returned (the reconcile)
a standing envelope: its marker and id (sse_ + 16 random bytes) and the process nonce, returned (the reconcile)
standing evidence with its nonce (32 random bytes), returned (the reconcile)
the Google OAuth login status, whose auth URL carries the drawn state and PKCE challenge (random_url_safe_token) (the reconcile)
a firewall receipt key store holding the signing key it mints when it has none (mint_key) (the reconcile)

the model-mount capability token plan (it forwards plan_capability_token_control): the ioi_mnt_ secret and its id (the reconcile; the ruled MUST: the sitting's model-mount and RUN-SCOPED tokens reach it)
the RUN-SCOPED model token (ioi_mnt_, through ModelMountCore::plan_capability_token_control), returned (the ruled MUST: the sitting's run-scoped token)
a governed approval claim with its claim nonce (claim_approval_ref), returned (the reconcile)
the justification checkpoint's record refs, under an interaction id (interaction_of) (the reconcile)
a capability lease minting decision with its approval claim (claim_approval_ref) (the reconcile)
a thread with its agent (build_agent_candidate: agent_ + UUIDv4), returned (the reconcile)
a portal exchange session token (issue_session_with_context), returned (the reconcile)
a session token (issue_session_with_context), returned (the reconcile)
a GitHub installation token obtained with a GitHub App JWT (mint_github_app_jwt), returned (the reconcile)
a standing envelope (create_standing_envelope), returned from its task (the reconcile)
the Google OAuth login status with its auth URL (google_auth::login), returned (the reconcile)
a firewall receipt key store holding its signing key (FirewallReceiptKeyStore::open), returned (the reconcile)
